<style>
/* Remove Quarto's normal page spacing */
#quarto-content,
.page-columns,
main.content {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

/* We don't need a second page title below the normal website navbar */
.quarto-title-block {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Container for the signup application */
.signup-page {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Make the Apps Script page fill the entire available area */
.presentation-signup-frame {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  border: 0;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}
</style>

<div class="signup-page">
<iframe
  id="presentationSignup"
  class="presentation-signup-frame"
  src="https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbxafzqI0tBfMKvUyoZqbqtOSYQfGFt1xboal0I0MqI-Vi-FXoSjJXxQJw7heXRrDiJLew/exec"
  allow="clipboard-write">
</iframe>
</div>

<script>
function resizeSignupPage() {
  const frame = document.getElementById("presentationSignup");
  const header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");

  const headerHeight = header
    ? header.getBoundingClientRect().height
    : 0;

  frame.style.height =
    `calc(100dvh - ${headerHeight}px)`;
}

window.addEventListener("load", resizeSignupPage);
window.addEventListener("resize", resizeSignupPage);
</script>
